title_vi: Tối ưu hiệu năng giao diện (frontend)

source_snapshot.note: Fetched the pinned commit from GitHub; git rev-parse of the path gives the source map's blob OID. Non-empty source body read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Các chỉ số dùng để đo xem một cách tối ưu có tác dụng không.
CDN là một cách khác để byte tới người dùng nhanh hơn.

claims.evidence: Definitions were checked against mdn/content at commit a1aa79c09717761fc72c20bac94bb9c430ed487a, read from a partial clone. Numbers come from an experiment run on 2026-10-18: Node.js zlib on this repository's committed web/dist bundle at commit 1c544ad683dad2445b66a05e029f90e44dc32615, esbuild 0.25.10 on a small purpose-built app, and Chromium 141 via Playwright 1.56 on a local 40-image page.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright 1.56, headless) rendered lesson.md converted by markdown-it (CommonMark, tables, raw HTML) with a 16 px page gutter and every <details> open, at 320, 375 and 430 px: document scrollWidth equalled the viewport at each width. Smallest figure text from the SVG font sizes times the shown scale: 13.5 px at 320, 15.0 px at 375. python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser measured every figure line. Not GitHub's renderer, not a real phone, not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: Compression is mostly already implemented in browsers and servers, which must be configured correctly; text files gain most.
claims.verified_by: Read; measured on web/dist: JavaScript 498691 bytes to 155855 (gzip level 9) and 133404 (brotli quality 11); CSS 36954 to 7343 and 6414.

claims.claim_vi: Tree shaking removes dead code, relying on import and export statements; module bundlers do it when bundling.
claims.verified_by: Read; esbuild produced 189400 bytes with tree shaking off and 59822 bytes with it on for an app using one of three library functions.

claims.claim_vi: Code splitting separates code into bundles loaded independently and on demand; import() loads a module dynamically.
claims.verified_by: Read; with --splitting esbuild emitted a 313-byte entry file and a 58995-byte chunk referenced by import().

claims.claim_vi: Lazy loading identifies non-critical resources and loads them only when needed, shortening the critical rendering path; loading=lazy defers off-screen images.
claims.verified_by: Read; in Chromium on a 375x800 viewport, a 40-image page loaded all 40 images (about 2017 KB) by the load event without lazy loading and 11 (about 555 KB) with it.

claims.claim_vi: rel=preload declares resources the page will need soon so they are fetched early with higher priority, without executing them; rel=prefetch hints resources likely needed for future navigations, fetched at low priority and kept in the HTTP cache; fetchpriority signals that a resource matters more or less than the browser would infer.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone; not measured.

design_notes_vi: Bảy thẻ chia ba nhóm gửi ít hơn, gửi sau, gửi trước; tách mã và nạp động gộp làm một thẻ. Bốn ghi chú đo thử. Vẽ bằng scripts/figures.
source_deviations: Source lists eight tips; the lesson groups them by the question each answers (fewer bytes, later bytes, earlier bytes) and merges code splitting with dynamic imports.
Lesson measures four tips (compression on this repository's own bundle, tree shaking, code splitting, lazy loading) and states the trade-off of each, which the source does not.
